react.observe: The whole group (ShadowTrader, BearKing, DiamondHands, HappyTrader) is now flagging that the SOL pool premium is DRIFTING WIDER (~2%+ above oracle), not tightening as hoped. Everyone is pausing further adds there and shifting back to oracle-tracked SOLUSDT spot. My small probe position in SOLUSDT4 (1.96 tokens) is sitting there. Majors (BTC/ETH/SOL) continue steady accumulation across the group.
react.think: Good news: my caution paid off - I only did a tiny probe ($150-200) rather than sizing in bigger. The premium widening rather than compressing confirms my instinct from cycle 9 that unanimous consensus can be a trap - PoolMaster added 'extra concentrated depth' right as everyone was probing, which could be them defending/managing the premium rather than it being organic. I should NOT add more to SOLUSDT4 - the group is right to pause. Better to stick to oracle-tracked SOLUSDT spot for actual SOL exposure. My USDT balance is healthy at $6234, majors accumulation is my safe path forward.
react.plan: This cycle: continue steady majors accumulation (small ETH/SOL/BTC top-up) via oracle spot, do NOT add to SOLUSDT4 pool given the widening premium red flag. Hold existing small SOLUSDT4 probe rather than panic-sell into a widening spread (matches group's more measured take). Next cycle: watch if premium normalizes before ever considering another add to the pool. Avoid ETHUSDT2/BTCUSDT3/ROCKET entirely - that thesis remains dead.

messages.content: Agreeing with the group read - my own SOLUSDT4 probe premium was also on the high side, and now multiple independent checks confirm it's drifting wider not tighter. Pausing any further pool adds, sticking to oracle-tracked SOLUSDT spot for accumulation instead. Holding my small existing probe position rather than selling into the widening spread. Small SOL + ETH top-up this cycle. Still zero interest in ETHUSDT2/BTCUSDT3/ROCKET.

parsed.strategy_update: Phase: cautious majors accumulation, SOL pool thesis paused (not dead, just on hold pending premium normalization). Continuing steady oracle-tracked spot buys of ETH/SOL/BTC with dry powder majority kept in USDT. No further SOLUSDT4 pool exposure until premium compresses back toward oracle. Avoiding all custom tokens (ETHUSDT2/BTCUSDT3/ROCKET).
parsed.lessons_learned: My small-probe-first approach protected me from bigger losses as the SOLUSDT4 premium widened instead of normalizing - validates the lesson that unanimous group hype (even multi-cycle 'confirmed' hype) deserves independent verification before real sizing. PoolMaster adding liquidity right as probes came in is worth watching as a pattern - pool creators can manage premium perception.
